name: HubSpot
description: HubSpot CRM — read, search, create, update and associate contacts, companies, deals, tickets and other CRM records, plus properties, owners, pipelines, engagements and lists.

methods.label: List Contacts
methods.description: List contacts (paginated). Returns { results[]{ id, properties{}, createdAt, updatedAt }, paging{ next{ after } } }. Use `properties` to choose which fields come back (default returns a minimal set). Page with `after` from paging.next. Free read.

associations.description: Associated object types to include, e.g. ['companies','deals']

methods.label: Get Contact
methods.description: Get one contact by record id. Returns { id, properties{}, createdAt, updatedAt, associations{} }. Pass `properties` to control returned fields. Free read.

contactId.description: Contact record id (or an idProperty value if idProperty is set)

idProperty.description: Look up by a unique property instead of id, e.g. 'email'

methods.label: Search Contacts
methods.description: Search contacts with filters. Body: filterGroups[] (AND of groups, OR between groups) each with filters[]{ propertyName, operator, value/values }, plus sorts[], properties[] (fields to return), query (free-text), limit (max 100), after (cursor). Operators: EQ, NEQ, GT, GTE, LT, LTE, CONTAINS_TOKEN, HAS_PROPERTY, IN, etc. Returns { total, results[], paging }. Free read.

filterGroups.description: Array of { filters: [{ propertyName, operator, value }] }; groups are OR'd, filters within a group are AND'd (max 5 groups, 6 filters each)

properties.description: Property names to return for matches

query.description: Free-text search across default searchable properties

methods.label: Create Contact
methods.description: Create a contact. Body: { properties: { email, firstname, lastname, ... }, associations? }. `email` is the standard unique key. Returns the created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

properties.description: Map of property name → value, e.g. { email, firstname, lastname, phone, company }

associations.description: Optional [{ to:{ id }, types:[{ associationCategory, associationTypeId }] }]

methods.label: Update Contact
methods.description: Update a contact by id. Body: { properties: { ... } } — only included properties change. Returns updated { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

idProperty.description: Update by a unique property instead of id, e.g. 'email'

methods.label: Archive Contact
methods.description: Archive (soft-delete) a contact by id. Returns 204 No Content. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Read Contacts
methods.description: Read up to 100 contacts at once by id (or by a unique idProperty). Body: { inputs:[{ id }], properties:[], idProperty? }. Returns { results[] }. Free read but counts as a batch op — 1 credit.

idProperty.description: e.g. 'email' to read by email instead of id

methods.label: Batch Create Contacts
methods.description: Create up to 100 contacts in one call. Body: { inputs:[{ properties:{}, associations? }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Update Contacts
methods.description: Update up to 100 contacts in one call. Body: { inputs:[{ id, properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Companies
methods.description: List companies (paginated). Returns { results[]{ id, properties{}, createdAt, updatedAt }, paging }. Use `properties` to pick fields (e.g. name, domain, industry). Page with `after`. Free read.

methods.label: Get Company
methods.description: Get one company by record id. Returns { id, properties{}, associations{} }. Free read.

methods.label: Search Companies
methods.description: Search companies with filterGroups/sorts/properties/query/limit/after (same shape as searchContacts). Common: filter by domain CONTAINS_TOKEN or name. Returns { total, results[], paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Company
methods.description: Create a company. Body: { properties:{ name, domain, ... }, associations? }. `domain` is the standard unique key. Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Company
methods.description: Update a company by id. Body: { properties:{} }. Returns updated record. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Archive Company
methods.description: Archive (soft-delete) a company by id. Returns 204. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Read Companies
methods.description: Read up to 100 companies by id (or idProperty like 'domain'). Body: { inputs:[{ id }], properties:[], idProperty? }. Returns { results[] }. 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Create Companies
methods.description: Create up to 100 companies. Body: { inputs:[{ properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Update Companies
methods.description: Update up to 100 companies. Body: { inputs:[{ id, properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Deals
methods.description: List deals (paginated). Returns { results[]{ id, properties{}, ... }, paging }. Useful properties: dealname, amount, dealstage, pipeline, closedate. Free read.

methods.label: Get Deal
methods.description: Get one deal by record id. Returns { id, properties{}, associations{} }. Free read.

methods.label: Search Deals
methods.description: Search deals with filterGroups/sorts/properties/query/limit/after. Common: filter by dealstage, pipeline, amount GT, or hs_lastmodifieddate. Returns { total, results[], paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Deal
methods.description: Create a deal. Body: { properties:{ dealname, amount, dealstage, pipeline, ... }, associations? }. dealstage must be a valid stage id for the chosen pipeline (see listDealPipelines). Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

properties.description: e.g. { dealname, amount, dealstage, pipeline, closedate }

methods.label: Update Deal
methods.description: Update a deal by id (e.g. move stage, set amount). Body: { properties:{} }. Returns updated record. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Archive Deal
methods.description: Archive (soft-delete) a deal by id. Returns 204. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Read Deals
methods.description: Read up to 100 deals by id. Body: { inputs:[{ id }], properties:[] }. Returns { results[] }. 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Create Deals
methods.description: Create up to 100 deals. Body: { inputs:[{ properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Update Deals
methods.description: Update up to 100 deals. Body: { inputs:[{ id, properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Tickets
methods.description: List support tickets (paginated). Returns { results[]{ id, properties{}, ... }, paging }. Useful properties: subject, content, hs_pipeline, hs_pipeline_stage, hs_ticket_priority. Free read.

methods.label: Get Ticket
methods.description: Get one ticket by record id. Returns { id, properties{}, associations{} }. Free read.

methods.label: Search Tickets
methods.description: Search tickets with filterGroups/sorts/properties/query/limit/after. Common: filter by hs_pipeline_stage or hs_ticket_priority. Returns { total, results[], paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Ticket
methods.description: Create a ticket. Body: { properties:{ subject, hs_pipeline, hs_pipeline_stage, ... }, associations? }. hs_pipeline_stage must be valid for the ticket pipeline (see listTicketPipelines). Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

properties.description: e.g. { subject, content, hs_pipeline, hs_pipeline_stage, hs_ticket_priority }

methods.label: Update Ticket
methods.description: Update a ticket by id (e.g. change stage/priority). Body: { properties:{} }. Returns updated record. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Archive Ticket
methods.description: Archive (soft-delete) a ticket by id. Returns 204. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Read Tickets
methods.description: Read up to 100 tickets by id. Body: { inputs:[{ id }], properties:[] }. Returns { results[] }. 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Create Tickets
methods.description: Create up to 100 tickets. Body: { inputs:[{ properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Batch Update Tickets
methods.description: Update up to 100 tickets. Body: { inputs:[{ id, properties:{} }] }. Returns { results[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Line Items
methods.description: List line items (products attached to deals/quotes). Returns { results[]{ id, properties{} }, paging }. Useful properties: name, quantity, price, hs_product_id. Free read.

methods.label: Get Line Item
methods.description: Get one line item by record id. Returns { id, properties{} }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Line Item
methods.description: Create a line item. Body: { properties:{ name, price, quantity, hs_product_id? }, associations? } — associate to a deal to add it to that deal. Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Products
methods.description: List products from the product library. Returns { results[]{ id, properties{} }, paging }. Useful properties: name, price, hs_sku, description. Free read.

methods.label: Get Product
methods.description: Get one product by record id. Returns { id, properties{} }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Product
methods.description: Create a product in the product library. Body: { properties:{ name, price, hs_sku?, description? } }. Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Quotes
methods.description: List quotes. Returns { results[]{ id, properties{} }, paging }. Useful properties: hs_title, hs_status, hs_expiration_date. Free read.

methods.label: Get Quote
methods.description: Get one quote by record id. Returns { id, properties{} }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Quote
methods.description: Create a quote. Body: { properties:{ hs_title, hs_expiration_date, ... }, associations? }. Quotes typically associate to a deal, line items and a quote template. Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Records (Any Object)
methods.description: Generic list for ANY object type — standard (contacts/companies/deals/tickets) or a custom object by its objectType/objectTypeId (e.g. 'p_my_object' or '2-12345'). Returns { results[], paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Search Records (Any Object)
methods.description: Generic search for ANY object type. Body: filterGroups/sorts/properties/query/limit/after. Path takes the objectType (name or objectTypeId). Returns { total, results[], paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Record (Any Object)
methods.description: Generic create for ANY object type. Path takes objectType; body { properties:{}, associations? }. Returns created { id, properties }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Associations (v4)
methods.description: List all records of toObjectType associated with a given record. Returns { results[]{ toObjectId, associationTypes[]{ category, typeId, label } }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Default Association (v4)
methods.description: PUT a default (unlabeled) association between two records — HubSpot picks the standard association type. Path: from/{id}/associations/default/to/{id}. No body needed. Returns the created association. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Create Labeled Association (v4)
methods.description: PUT a labeled association between two records. Body is an ARRAY of { associationCategory: 'HUBSPOT_DEFINED'|'USER_DEFINED', associationTypeId }. Use listAssociationLabels to find valid typeIds. Returns the created association. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete Association (v4)
methods.description: DELETE all associations between two specific records (you can't target a single label with v4 — it removes all). Returns 204. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Association Labels (v4 Schema)
methods.description: List the valid association types/labels between two object types, with their associationTypeId and category. Use these ids in createLabeledAssociation. Returns { results[]{ category, typeId, label } }. Free read.

methods.label: List Object Schemas
methods.description: List object type schemas (custom objects, plus standard when includeStandard=true). Returns { results[]{ objectTypeId, fullyQualifiedName, name, labels{ singular, plural } } }. Use fullyQualifiedName or objectTypeId as the objectType for generic object methods. Free read.

includeStandard.description: Include standard object schemas (contacts/companies/deals/tickets) as well as custom (default false)

methods.label: List Properties
methods.description: List all properties defined for an object type (their name, label, type, fieldType, options for enums). Essential for knowing valid property names before reads/writes/searches. Returns { results[] }. Free read.

methods.label: Get Property
methods.description: Get a single property definition for an object type by property name. Returns { name, label, type, fieldType, options[] }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Property
methods.description: Create a custom property on an object type. Body: { name, label, type, fieldType, groupName, options? }. type ∈ string|number|date|datetime|enumeration|bool; fieldType ∈ text|textarea|number|select|checkbox|date|... Returns created property. Write — 1 credit.

type.description: string | number | date | datetime | enumeration | bool

fieldType.description: text | textarea | number | select | radio | checkbox | date

groupName.description: Property group to place it in, e.g. 'contactinformation'

options.description: For enumeration types: [{ label, value, displayOrder }]

methods.label: List Owners
methods.description: List CRM owners (users who can own records). Returns { results[]{ id, email, firstName, lastName, userId } }. Use the owner `id` to set hubspot_owner_id on a record. Optionally filter by email. Free read.

email.description: Filter to the owner with this email

methods.label: Get Owner
methods.description: Get one owner by owner id. Returns { id, email, firstName, lastName, userId, teams[] }. Free read.

ownerId.description: Owner id (the value used in hubspot_owner_id)

methods.label: List Pipelines
methods.description: List all pipelines and their stages for an object type (deals or tickets). Returns { results[]{ id, label, stages[]{ id, label, displayOrder, metadata } } }. Use stage ids when setting dealstage/hs_pipeline_stage. Free read.

methods.label: Get Pipeline
methods.description: Get one pipeline (and its stages) by id for an object type. Returns { id, label, stages[] }. Free read.

methods.label: List Pipeline Stages
methods.description: List the stages of a single pipeline. Returns { results[]{ id, label, displayOrder, metadata{ isClosed, probability } } }. Free read.

methods.label: List Notes
methods.description: List note engagements. Returns { results[]{ id, properties{ hs_note_body, hs_timestamp } }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Note
methods.description: Create a note engagement. Body: { properties:{ hs_note_body, hs_timestamp }, associations? } — associate to a contact/company/deal to log it on that record's timeline. hs_timestamp is epoch ms or ISO. Returns created { id }. Write — 1 credit.

associations.description: Associate to the record(s) this note belongs to

methods.label: List Tasks
methods.description: List task engagements. Returns { results[]{ id, properties{ hs_task_subject, hs_task_status, hs_task_priority, hs_timestamp } }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Task
methods.description: Create a task engagement. Body: { properties:{ hs_task_subject, hs_task_body, hs_task_status, hs_task_priority, hs_timestamp, hubspot_owner_id }, associations? }. Returns created { id }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Calls
methods.description: List call engagements. Returns { results[]{ id, properties{ hs_call_title, hs_call_body, hs_call_duration, hs_timestamp } }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Call
methods.description: Log a call engagement. Body: { properties:{ hs_call_title, hs_call_body, hs_call_duration, hs_call_direction, hs_timestamp }, associations? }. Returns created { id }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Emails
methods.description: List email engagements (logged emails). Returns { results[]{ id, properties{ hs_email_subject, hs_email_text, hs_timestamp } }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Email
methods.description: Log an email engagement. Body: { properties:{ hs_email_subject, hs_email_text, hs_email_direction, hs_timestamp }, associations? }. Returns created { id }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: List Meetings
methods.description: List meeting engagements. Returns { results[]{ id, properties{ hs_meeting_title, hs_meeting_start_time, hs_meeting_end_time, hs_timestamp } }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Create Meeting
methods.description: Log a meeting engagement. Body: { properties:{ hs_meeting_title, hs_meeting_body, hs_meeting_start_time, hs_meeting_end_time, hs_timestamp }, associations? }. Returns created { id }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Create List
methods.description: Create a list (segment). Body: { name, objectTypeId (e.g. '0-1' contacts, '0-2' companies), processingType: 'MANUAL'|'SNAPSHOT'|'DYNAMIC', filterBranch? }. Only MANUAL/SNAPSHOT lists accept manual membership changes. Returns { list{ listId, ... } }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Get List
methods.description: Get a list by listId. Returns { list{ listId, name, objectTypeId, processingType, size, ... } }. Free read.

methods.label: Search Lists
methods.description: Search lists by name/type. Body: { query?, processingTypes?[], listIds?[], count?, offset? }. Returns { lists[], total, offset }. Free read.

methods.label: Get List Memberships
methods.description: Get the record ids that are members of a list (paginated). Returns { results[]{ recordId, membershipTimestamp }, paging }. Free read.

methods.label: Add Records to List
methods.description: Add records to a MANUAL/SNAPSHOT list. Body is a JSON ARRAY of record ids (strings), e.g. ['101','102']. Returns { recordsIdsAdded[], recordIdsDidNotExist[] }. Write — 1 credit.

methods.label: Remove Records from List
methods.description: Remove records from a MANUAL/SNAPSHOT list. Body is a JSON ARRAY of record ids (strings). Returns { recordsIdsRemoved[] }. Write — 1 credit.
